title: DB Snapshots config
description: Project config for the dbs CLI (.db-snapshots.json).

$schema.description: Reference to this schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

default_connection.description: Name of the Connection used when none is given.

storage.description: Snapshot Storage directory, relative to the config file's directory.

connections.description: Named Connections; at least one is required.

driver.description: The database engine this Connection speaks (mysql also covers MariaDB).

port.description: Port number, or a string so it can be interpolated.

password.description: Use a ${VAR} reference rather than a literal password.
